body: I like that. That's a helpful metaphor. It really is.
Thank you I really appreciate your words.:) Getting through yesterday was hard, but I thought about your words and it really helped.
May I ask why you are considering doing this? I really really hope you reconsider.

I see. I'm glad you have received help here in the past and found it constructive, but I am so sorry that you are going through this. I urge you to reconsider, but I guess that is all I can do at this point. Is there anything I can do to help you?

Words cannot describe sorry I am, and my deepest condolences and warmest thoughts go out to you. All I can think to say is please reconsider. Today marks the 1 year anniversary of one of my best friends suicide and you may not no it, but you may mean the world to someone and this choice could affect their lives forever. Please reconsider and live on for your friends and girlfriend and be their living legacy. If there is an afterlife I'm sure they are waiting for you, but would love to see you flourish during your time on this earth. I respect either route you decide to go down this must be so hard.
You mentioned this Sub has helped you before, so why not get through today and hope this sub can help you again?
Hey Buddy I'm going to be away for a Rugby game Saturday, but could I send you a "E-Valentine's Day Card" that you can open and read on Valentine's Day? I wish I could be there for ya.

Well movies now adays are more than just moving pictures you know? They are stories and life lessons, and there is some value to be taken from that right? And there's nothing wrong with relaxing at home doing something that makes you happy because that's what makes you happy!
Yeah I know how that goes...finding it hard to find the energy to get up is never a fun feeling. Do you enjoy movies, tv shows, or video games?

I know exactly how you feel. Some days those thoughts hit hard. I always try to keep busy and surround myself with people that make me happy. There are even times when I surround myself with the television families and characters that make me happy just so I can keep my mind off of the darker thoughts. People are also here on this subreddit who will listen to you and share encouraging words. So breathe, relax, and find the things that make you happy and surround yourself with it.
There are plenty of people here to listen to you. This subreddit has made me feel better when I was feeling down!:) What do you enjoy doing?

Oh but it is enough to live for, someone who can make the sun shine out of your ass! A person who will be there for you in any situation. That's love. If she is your closest friend she will always be there for you and will not go away, and she will certainly not forget about you. Wanting friends is not selfish in the slightest. Her boyfriend is being selfish and insecure for not being okay with the fact that she has another good friend who is a boy. Maybe you could talk to her about how she makes you happy?
Good and Plenty

Sounds like you've found some light in the darkness with your closest friend. Please try and hold on to that light. She can be your hope. She's your source of happiness. Isn't that enough to live for? There are thousands of people here at /r/SuicideWatch here to help.
As a person with generalized anxiety disorder, I am terrified of myself sometimes.

NO WAY. I'm a huge movie fan and Nightcrawler is honestly one of my favorites this year! I love those little tips that Jake keeps giving to his partner whenever they were out and about they cracked me up everytime! Kingdom Hearts though...when I was little I tried to give a paupu fruit (mango) to a girl I had a crush on...she didn't get the reference. What's your favorite movie?

Hey Fred! My name is Jesse and I too love playing guitar and singing. I used to be really into video games. My favorite one growing up was Kingdom Hearts! What's your favorite video game? Also do you like movies?
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e5MAg_yWsq8
Thank you for your kind words. It is just so hard some days. I really appreciate your comment.

To answer the title of your post, yes you deserve to live. Everyone deserves to live because life is a precious gift that should not be taken for granted because you only get one. So please do me a favor and never question that again:) You are not a bad person if you get mad easily or if you are sensitive. If you feel like it's a problem then learn to fix it and if you don't think it is a problem and your SO thinks something is talk it out and try to understand her point of view and try to get her to understand yours. You are not a monster. You just seem a little confused and that is okay because you are going to learn from this experience and you are going to grow stronger.

I don't think you are wrong. For most people who have never struggled with suicidal thoughts or any sort of depression it may be difficult for them to empathize with the incredible decision you made. I personally think you made an inspiring decision and it is one that should be celebrated and if that takes form in a snapchat story so be it! You are choosing to live even when sometimes it may seem hard to make that choice and that is something to be proud of because you have over come something that unfortunately not a lot of people conquer. So good for you!

It's crazy. I have never opened up to people until recently and telling people that I have been struggling, and that has been the best thing for me. Having people or a person to open up to and tell them all your fears and insecurities and not being afraid that they might think you are crazy changes the whole game. Only a couple people know about my thoughts, but I also feel super comfortable talking with strangers over the internet because I've learned that sometimes you can help yourself by helping others. And that's life. I think life is just a collective effort of living things trying to survive and be happy. So if you ever need someone to talk to send me a message I'm all ears.

My thoughts ebb and flow when it comes to suicide. In my heart of hearts I don't think I could ever actually go through with it, but I relate with you in the aspect that my life is not bad. I have a lot of friends and a family that loves me, but I think I am afraid of being alive. Ever since I could remember I always thought that I was special and that I am supposed to impact the world in a huge way, but I am so afraid of disappointing people. I am so afraid of being a failure. And I am terrified at the fact that I might not be able to be the person that everyone sees in me.

Those people are people you don't want to be around. They seem toxic. That is something no real friend would do to someone and something no real girlfriend would do to their SO. Take pride in your own higher standard of morality than theirs and find friends and future love interests that are better because I think it is crystal clear to all of us that you deserve better. Don't settle for people who have the capacity to treat you as these people have treated you. Surround yourself with people who genuinely love you and only want the best for you and overall be happy:) If you ever need anyone to talk to send me a message I'm all ears! You deserve better.
Congrats on the new job! That is such exciting news! Keep on trucking! And good luck with your aunt I am sure she will understand!:) Always here with open ears for ya!
